worldcombat.skill.storedpower.summary: Releases empowerment as a psychic burst that damages and pushes nearby enemies. Spend form increases power and area, then consumes positive stat stages and native buffs after a hit.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.use.0: Stack stat stages, then release point-blank
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.use.1: Catch everyone crowded around you at once
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.use.2: Spend the whole stash for one maximum burst
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.descriptio: Each enemy hit takes about %1$s special damage. The current %2$s stored levels are already included in damage and area. All seven positive stat stages and potion/beacon buffs count; level I counts once.
Hits each enemy once within a %1$s-block radius and attempts to push them %2$s blocks outward.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.spend.on: Spend: power ×1.35 and radius ×1.2. Hitting at least one enemy consumes all positive stat stages and potion/beacon buffs; cooldown increases by six ticks.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.spend.off: Keep form: stages stay on the user, power and radius are standard, and the cooldown is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s committed cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.growth.0: From level %1$s: release power %2$s, radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.growth.1: From level %1$s: release power %2$s, radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.storedpower.preference: On (spend): on a hit, throw every positive stat stage out with the blast for x1.35 power and x1.2 radius, but the stages clear and the cooldown is +6. Off: stages stay on you, power and radius are standard and the cooldown is shorter. Banking and spending each have their own opening.

Within this distance it is willing to open with the nova; beyond it the priority drops low (the shared approach still walks it in). The nova is centred on the user, so a larger value only starts it a little sooner.
On: each positive stage raises the priority further, so a deeper stash is more willingly spent. Off: ignore the stash and rank it as an ordinary close-range area attack.
